
```
{'create_pool_apply_async': 'create a TBB Pool and apply a function asynchronously to get an ApplyResult object', 'create_pool_map_parallel': 'create a TBB Pool and map a function over an iterable in parallel', 'create_pool_imap_ordered': 'create a TBB Pool and use imap to iterate over results in submission order', 'create_pool_imap_unordered': 'create a TBB Pool and use imap_unordered to iterate over results as they complete', 'create_pool_context_manager': 'create a TBB Pool as a context manager to auto join worker threads on exit'}
```
